answer.thought: The haze outside is still thick, a grey blanket that makes the white kurta look dirty before I have even stepped onto the verandah. It is nearly one o'clock, and the silence in the house is heavy, pressing against the ears. I am not ready to move; the air itself seems to resist the motion of the body, a physical manifestation of the stagnation I feel in my own thinking. I will sit still for a while, letting the heat settle into the bones, and wait for the moment when the mind is clear enough to return to the file.
